crossrefs.text: Then I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for My anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.”
Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
Tie them to your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
For everyone will be salted with fire.
Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”
On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
So the whole congregation took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, along with wine, grapes, and figs. All kinds of goods were being brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. So I warned them against selling food on that day.
but I warned them, “Why are you camping in front of the wall? If you do it again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they did not return on the Sabbath.

Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.

For if you will indeed carry out these commands, then kings who sit on Davidʼs throne will enter through the gates of this palace riding on chariots and horses—they and their officials and their people.
I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

groups.title: The royal line: Judah to David to Jesus
